notes.title: CUBE-C history of the lowest discount! And free trial to cancel notice...
notes.content:
[h1][b]Why is discount so big?[/b][/h1]
CUBE-C are in the history biggest discount now! Why such a big discount? Because I entered the wrong discount, it should 44%, and now 56% ... But in any case, I assure you that after this winter CUBE-C will never call such a low discount! Please give me some support！

[h1][b]Free trial cancel reason[/b][/h1]
Free demo canceled because I am too busy, and do not know the game need to review the DEMO again, and now the discount has been so low, at least 3 months CUBE-C will not be doing free trial, I hope you understand!

[h1][b]Game update progress notice[/b][/h1]
CUBE-C is making a tutorial level now, please look forward to it!

[h1][b]Free key ban notice[/b][/h1]
If you have not given me any comments and evaluation of CUBE-C, your Key will be banned when the discount start!

notes.title: CUBE-C has been updated to version 0.0.7!
notes.content:
This update adds many new features and changes some old ones!

[h1][b]Important changes:[/b][/h1]
[u][b]The box will no longer be automatically scored! You have to gather scattered squares, otherwise, you will not get points, that is, you can not upgrade![/b][/u]

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[b]CUBE Vacuum Cleaner
Take two hands close up, palm-to-palm, there will be an attraction, the CUBEs will be sucked in, in order to gain points from the CUBEs. (If you let the CUBE be there, you will no longer get any points and upgraded! Please wait for the help file with animation next week!)[/b]

BUG fix
On GAMEOVER interface, the button on cannot be pressed, because the player becomes bigger (these menus which are normal in the level1, it some kind of strange VR errors), now when GAMEOVER will countdown 5 seconds and automatically restart! The next update will completely adopt the menu selection method, so stay tuned!
